'''hjedi At Last We Will Have Our Revenge''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[hjedi]]
* '''Published:''' 8 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Let Them Make The First Move|Ref3-D-letthemmakethefirstmove.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Let Them Make The First Move
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed FirstMove hjedi DS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

this is a powerful solid deck that i built ages ago. have won 5-1 games so far.

The published list has 66 cards.
